{"items":[{"id":"r_4cffe9ec-09a8-4d1b-881c-4468997e8f70","title":"Business Development Associate","team":"ViscoTrack","location":"Bangalore","workMode":"on_site","jobType":"contract","experience":"student_0_1","jobFamily":"Customer Discovery, Partnerships & Technical Advisory","subFamily":"Marketing & Communications Management","tirEntity":"Resonant liquid property sensors","tirOverview":"Resonant sensors — electromagnetically actuated, cm-scale sensors that measure liquid viscosity, density and surface tension in real time.","jd":{"summary":"Take a world-first liquid sensor from IISc research to its first customers: find them, qualify them, run pilots with them and close the first deals together with the founder.","about":"We are ViscoTrack, a deep-tech startup from research at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), incubated at ARTPARK, IISc. Our novel, patented technology is the first in the world to measure the viscosity, density and surface tension of a liquid simultaneously, from a single drop in seconds. We are turning it into two products: a tabletop instrument for R&D and QC labs, and an inline sensor for production lines and machines. Companies in oil and lubricants, pharma, chemicals and consumer goods are already talking to us.

You will be our first business development hire and work directly with the founder. Your job is to turn this interest into commitments: find the right customers, learn how they measure today and what it costs them, run pilots with them, and close our first pilot agreements and orders.

The plan you'll work to: by December we choose one customer segment and one champion customer and agree the product specification with them. By January we sign a pilot MoU or paid proof of concept and line up two more interested customers. In February and March the pilot runs at the customer's site, and we collect results and letters of intent and draw up our first sales roadmap.

Team: the founder (inventor of the sensor, scientist; PhD and 10 years of research in viscosity and density sensors), Ebinesh Abraham (electronics system designer), and our product designer and mechanical engineer. Advisors: Prof. Prosenjit Sen and Prof. G. K. Ananthasuresh (IISc). Mentor: Raghu, CEO of ARTPARK.

Engagement: consulting contract through ARTPARK, IISc (profile "Consultant at ARTPARK, IISc"); funded to March 2027, with the next funding expected by February 2027. Six days a week in the office at ARTgarage, IISc, Bengaluru; travel to customer labs and plants when needed; no side projects; NDA before you start. Join immediately or by 1 December 2026.","doing":["Find and open doors: build target lists of companies and the right people in them (lab heads, QC managers, plant and reliability engineers, R&D leaders), and reach them by LinkedIn, email, phone and visits","Qualify: in customer meetings, learn how they measure today, what it costs them, who decides and who pays; log every conversation in our CRM","Run pilots: coordinate samples, demos and site visits with our engineers, and keep the customer informed and the pilot on schedule","Close: draft pilot proposals, MoUs and paid proof-of-concept terms with the founder, and win letters of intent from more customers in the same segment","Keep the evidence: maintain the CRM, the competitor and market analysis, and the plan tracker we report to ARTPARK"],"looking":["A degree in engineering or science (B.E./B.Tech in Chemical, Mechanical, Instrumentation, Electronics or similar; or B.Sc./M.Sc./PhD in Chemistry, Physics, Materials or similar) and an MBA (completed, or completing in 2026)","0 to 3 years of experience, and a clear wish to build a career in sales of technical products","You enjoy talking to customers and can explain a technical product in plain words","Clear writing, disciplined follow-up, and comfort with spreadsheets and a CRM","Happy to travel to labs and plants, and not discouraged by a no"],"nice":["Technical sales, application support or a sales internship, especially with lab instruments or process sensors","Contacts or experience in oil and lubricants, pharma, chemicals or consumer goods","Experience preparing proposals, quotations or market sizing"]},"postedAt":"2026-11-14T05:12:26.516Z"},{"id":"r_b00de955-b158-4a25-b954-be70a078f2fa","title":"Product Designer","team":"ViscoTrack","location":"Bangalore","workMode":"on_site","jobType":"contract","experience":"student_0_1","jobFamily":"Design, Human Factors & User Experience","subFamily":"Product & Visual Design","tirEntity":"Resonant liquid property sensors","tirOverview":"Resonant sensors — electromagnetically actuated, cm-scale sensors that measure liquid viscosity, density and surface tension in real time.","jd":{"summary":"Be the first designer on a single-drop liquid sensor — owning form, ergonomics and user experience from first sketch to customer pilot.","about":"ViscoTrack is a deep-tech startup from research at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), incubated at ARTPARK, IISc. Our patented technology is the first to measure the viscosity, density and surface tension of a liquid simultaneously, from a single drop of about 10 µL in about 10 seconds. We are turning it into two made-in-India products: a tabletop instrument for R&D and QC labs, and an inline sensor for production lines in pharma, chemicals and other process industries.

As our first designer, you'll define how both products look, feel and work, alongside our scientist (the inventor of the sensor) and our electronics designer, with advice from IISc professors. The work is on-site at ARTgarage, IISc, Bengaluru: a 6-day week with travel to labs and plants, towards customer pilots by March 2027.

The next four months:
- December: choose one customer segment with a severe pain point and set the product specification with an anchor customer.
- January: build a benchtop prototype and test it on that customer's liquids.
- February–March: run the pilot with the customer and iterate, reaching TRL 5 by the end of March 2027.

We are looking for someone who can join immediately.

Engagement terms: a consulting contract through ARTPARK, IISc (profile "Consultant at ARTPARK, IISc").","doing":["Lead customer discovery: we have the technology, and you will find the customer segment with a severe pain point that it solves, by interviewing lab scientists, QC teams and plant engineers across industries, using sketches, mock-ups and concept renders to test ideas with customers","Run user research (interviews, site visits and observation in labs and plants) and turn what users need into the product specification","Own the product design of the tabletop instrument and the inline sensor: form, ergonomics, sample loading and how users read results, for lab scientists, QC teams and plant engineers","Turn sketches into CAD and build prototypes (3D-printed, machined and sheet-metal parts) integrated with our sensor and electronics","Design enclosures fit for labs and plants: chemical-resistant, easy-to-clean materials, sealing against liquids, mounting on benches and process lines","Test prototypes with real users, record what fails, and iterate design, prototype and test in short cycles","Prepare designs for manufacture with Indian vendors (DFM, drawings, tolerances, BOM) as we move to the customer pilot by March 2027","Support the customer pilot on site: set up the prototype, train users, collect feedback and turn it into design changes"],"looking":["M.Des in Product or Industrial Design with a B.E./B.Tech in any branch (Mechanical, ECE, EEE, Instrumentation and others);
